passages.text: The Ca2+ sensor STIM1 regulates the type I interferon response by retaining the signaling adaptor STING at the endoplasmic reticulum.

STIM1 deficiency results in spontaneous STING activation.
Loss of STIM1 in human cells enhances type I IFN expression.
We found that STIM1 interacts with STING via its “dimerization” domain.
Ishikawa H. STING regulates intracellular DNA-mediated innate immune signalling.
STIM1 binds ORAI1 to gate CRAC channels.
